title: AWS_VPC_ENI_MTU / POD_MTU outside 576–9001 (1280–9001 on IPv6) stop aws-node from starting (v1.16.4)

detection.reason: the MTU VALUES are not collected (env names only)

remediation: From v1.16.4 the aws-node entrypoint validates AWS_VPC_ENI_MTU and POD_MTU before installing the CNI binaries and exits on a non-integer or a value below 576 (1280 when ENABLE_IPv6=true) or above 9001 — the DaemonSet crash-loops and new pods get no IP. Fix the values before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[] | .name as $c | .env[]? | select(.name | test("^(AWS_VPC_ENI_MTU|POD_MTU)$")) | "\($c): \(.name)=\(.value // "(from \(.valueFrom | keys | join(",")))")"'  # a value that is not an integer in 576-9001 (1280-9001 on IPv6) makes v1.16.4+ exit at startup
